text:
maria.ng: Heads-up — I'm triaging a region-wide spike in 5xx for multiple models. Does anyone have an existing saved search that shows p95 latency and 5xx counts by org / model / route / region I can reuse? Prefer something I can quickly filter by time-range and region. Example query I'm trying locally:
```
service:inference AND status >= 500 | stats p95(latency_ms) as p95_ms, count(status) as error_count by org_id, model, route, region | sort -error_count
```
Can someone point me to a savedsearch or shortcut?

ajay: There is a saved search under Saved Searches -> Ops -> cross-org-route-status but it's a bit old. Link: https://internal.redwood.com/logs/saved/ops-cross-route-status. It shows counts by route/org and has filters for region/time. Might need a small tweak to include p95.

sam.k: If you want to add p95, use this variant — it runs faster with pre-filtering: 
```
index=inference_logs "status">=500 route=* | where region=\"eu\" | stats p95(latency_ms) as p95_ms, count() as errors by org_id, model, route | sort -errors
```
You can save as a new preset and tag it `eng-sre/route-status-p95`.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-022 — linked to this thread. Priority: P2. (automated alert: 5xx spike in eu region)

leo: I can create a cleaned-up saved search and pin it to the team lib. What name do you want? `eng-sre/route-p95-5xx` ok? Also, do we want an alert rule that fires on p95_ms > 300ms or errors rate > 1%?

maria.ng: `eng-sre/route-p95-5xx` sounds good. For alerts: let's create two conditions — 1) p95_ms over 300ms sustained for 5m, 2) 5xx error rate > 1% over 5m. Please expose `org_id` and `model` as group-by fields in the saved search so customers can drill down.

ajay: Alert expressions I'd use (pseudo-syntax): 
```
condition A: eval(p95(latency_ms)) by route,model,org_id > 300 for 5m
condition B: error_count / total_requests by route,model,org_id > 0.01 for 5m
```
We should also add a `region` filter param in the saved search UI so oncall can narrow to ap-sg, eu, us-west quickly.

leo: Done — created saved search and pinned to eng-sre > shared-presets. Link: https://internal.redwood.com/logs/saved/eng-sre-route-p95-5xx. I've added region and time macros, and the two alert conditions as draft rules (need an ops owner to enable).

maria.ng: Awesome, thanks @leo :thumbsup: — linking this saved search in the incident. Can someone from ops enable the alerts and add escalation?

sam.k: I'll pick up alert enablement and escalation mapping today. If anyone has preferences for pager thresholds, DM me.

leo: I also added a short description and example quick-filters: `region:eu`, `model:zenith*`, `status:[500 TO 599]`. If you want a different default grouping order (by error_count desc), tell me.

maria.ng: Default ordering by error_count desc is perfect. Thanks all — closing the loop here.
